evidence.title: How Democrats eyeing 2028 won and lost in primaries they endorsed in

occurrences.checkable_against: New Hampshire 1st District 2026 Democratic primary candidate filings and Kelly endorsement statement
occurrences.quote_span: In next week’s primary in New Hampshire’s 1st District, Kelly is supporting Stefany Shaheen, the daughter of his Senate colleague Jeanne Shaheen, praising her as a “fearless leader” who would stand up to President Donald Trump.
occurrences.speaker: Mark Kelly
occurrences.subject: 2026 Democratic primary endorsements by potential presidential candidates

occurrences.checkable_against: Kentucky 2026 primary calendar and Beshear endorsement announcements
occurrences.quote_span: Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear endorsed after primaries in his home state were complete.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own

occurrences.checkable_against: Wisconsin 3rd District and Connecticut 2026 Democratic primary results
occurrences.quote_span: Buttigieg, who has said he is “more inclined than not” to run for president again in 2028, has also notched endorsement wins with Rebecca Cooke in Wisconsin’s battleground 3rd District and former Hartford Mayor Luke Bronin in Connecticut, who defeated incumbent Rep. John Larson earlier this month.
occurrences.speaker: Pete Buttigieg
occurrences.subject: 2026 Democratic primary endorsements by potential presidential candidates

occurrences.checkable_against: Campaign-event records and Michigan Democratic Senate primary results
occurrences.quote_span: Ocasio-Cortez actively campaigned for progressives in several contested battleground primaries, rallying with Sam Forstag in Montana and alongside Sanders with Abdul El-Sayed, who narrowly won the Democratic Senate nomination in Michigan.

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania 7th District candidate filings and primary records
occurrences.quote_span: Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro expended significant political capital in one of Democrats’ top House targets in his state, helping recruit longtime ally and firefighter union chief Bob Brooks into the race against GOP Rep. Ryan Mackenzie in the state’s swingy 7th District and then working to elevate him out of a four-way primary .
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 Democratic primary endorsements by potential presidential candidates

occurrences.checkable_against: Slotkin endorsement announcement date and Michigan 7th District primary date
occurrences.quote_span: The person also acknowledged that Slotkin’s decision to wait to issue her endorsement until three weeks before the primary didn’t leave enough time for voters and party leaders to coalesce around Maasdam.
occurrences.speaker: person familiar with Slotkin’s thinking
occurrences.subject: 2026 Democratic primary endorsements by potential presidential candidates

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement from Marisol Samayoa or Kelly campaign communications
occurrences.quote_span: “As Navy combat veteran and former NASA astronaut, Mark Kelly knows the country is best served by leaders who represent their communities and bring a range of different backgrounds and experiences to the job. It’s why he’s endorsed candidates in competitive primaries and campaigned for Democrats up and down the ballot,” Kelly spokesperson Marisol Samayoa said.
occurrences.speaker: Mark Kelly spokesperson Marisol Samayoa
occurrences.subject: 2026 Democratic primary endorsements by potential presidential candidates

occurrences.checkable_against: New Hampshire and Massachusetts 2026 Democratic primary candidate filings and Sherrill endorsement announcements
occurrences.quote_span: New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill also went on a recent endorsement spree focused on military veterans . But she’s backing Maura Sullivan in the race against Shaheen next week, along with Rep. Seth Moulton in his primary against Sen. Ed Markey, who has gotten backing from progressives including Ocasio-Cortez.
occurrences.speaker: Mikie Sherrill
occurrences.subject: 2026 Democratic primary endorsements by potential presidential candidates

occurrences.checkable_against: Illinois campaign-finance filings and campaign-event records
occurrences.quote_span: Pritzker pumped $10 million into a super PAC supporting his lieutenant governor, Juliana Stratton, in the contentious Senate primary to replace retiring Sen. Dick Durbin, and appeared alongside her on the campaign trail.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 Democratic primary endorsements by potential presidential candidates

occurrences.checkable_against: Harris endorsement statements and competitive-primary endorsement records
occurrences.quote_span: And Kamala Harris declined to weigh in on the majority of competitive primaries because of her high profile, according to a person familiar with her thinking who was granted anonymity to speak candidly.
occurrences.speaker: person familiar with Kamala Harris's thinking
occurrences.subject: 2026 Democratic primary endorsements by potential presidential candidates

occurrences.checkable_against: Pennsylvania 7th District 2026 primary results and campaign records
occurrences.quote_span: Shapiro fundraised for Brooks, cut an ad for him and joined him on the stump ahead of Election Day; Brooks won by nearly 20 points.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2026 Democratic primary endorsements by potential presidential candidates

occurrences.checkable_against: Whitmer endorsement announcement and Michigan Senate primary campaign records
occurrences.quote_span: Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer also stuck to her state, only really playing in Michigan’s high-profile Senate race. She endorsed Rep. Haley Stevens in the final stretch of the race, although she wasn’t active on the campaign trail in the same way Pritzker was for Stratton or Shapiro for Brooks.
occurrences.speaker: Gretchen Whitmer
occurrences.subject: 2026 Democratic primary endorsements by potential presidential candidates
